svg.title: Alberta categorical sections
svg.desc: Four sections of the Alberta grid at row 28, one per engine and prior, coloured by the category most often simulated in 32 realizations, with the 36 conditioning cells of the training holes outlined. The cover is layered in all four; the basement granitoid differs between priors.
svg.text: Alberta, hole-group split: the most probable category over 32 realizations, west-east row 28
Outlined cells are conditioned by training holes; 250 m cells, 10 m layers, depth down.
Direct Sampling (GeoCond, zoned), northwest high-strain fabric
